cards.audioText: What kinds of serious failures may force a large jet airliner to ditch on the sea?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些严重故障可能迫使大型喷气客机在海上迫降？
cards.referenceText: This situation is related to Sea ditching. I would identify the threat, communicate clearly, follow the checklist, and choose the safest option according to aircraft status and operating conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这种情况与水上迫降有关。我会识别威胁，清楚沟通，执行检查单，并根据飞机状态和运行条件选择最安全的方案。

cards.audioText: As captain, if all engines fail over water, what full set of procedures will you follow to complete a safe ditching?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，如果在水面上空所有发动机失效，你会遵循哪些完整程序完成安全迫降？
cards.referenceText: I would brief the threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with ATC and the crew, and follow the checklist. If safety is not assured, I would delay, discontinue, reject, go around, or divert as appropriate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会完成威胁简令，检查相关飞机系统和性能，与管制和机组协同，并执行检查单。如果安全无法保证，我会根据情况选择延误、中止、拒绝起飞、复飞或备降。

cards.audioText: After successfully ditching on the sea, what evacuation steps should the flight crew carry out immediately?
cards.audioTextZh: 成功水上迫降后，机组应立即执行哪些撤离步骤？
cards.referenceText: This situation is related to Sea ditching. I would identify the threat, communicate clearly, follow the checklist, and choose the safest option according to aircraft status and operating conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这种情况与水上迫降有关。我会识别威胁，清楚沟通，执行检查单，并根据飞机状态和运行条件选择最安全的方案。
